title: MAGIC ENGLISH BEGINNER — WORLD 10: A2 FINAL MASTERY & REAL-WORLD ENGLISH
description: The final Grade 1 world consolidates the full beginner-to-A2 journey through independent communication, richer real-life scenarios, longer comprehension, practical writing, storytelling, problem solving and a comprehensive final mastery quest.

missions.title: A2 Word Power — 750+ Challenge
missions.focus: high-frequency vocabulary, collocations, word families, opposites and useful communication chunks

missions.title: Grammar Mission Control
missions.focus: choosing accurate present, past and future forms in meaningful communication

missions.title: Tell Me About Your Life
missions.focus: personal information, routines, experiences, achievements, preferences and future goals

missions.title: Past, Present & Future Story
missions.focus: connecting different time frames into one coherent spoken and written story

missions.title: Advice, Rules & Choices
missions.focus: must, have to, should, can, could, need to and don't have to in practical situations

missions.title: Everyday Problem Solver
missions.focus: identify a problem, explain what happened, ask for help, suggest options and choose a solution

missions.title: School & Learning English
missions.focus: subjects, assignments, instructions, questions, study habits and explaining learning difficulties

missions.title: Work & Future Dreams
missions.focus: jobs, responsibilities, skills, simple interview questions, ambitions and future plans

missions.title: Digital Life & Online English
missions.focus: devices, messages, accounts, basic online safety, instructions and digital communication

missions.title: A2 Conversation Lab — Ten Minutes
missions.focus: sustained conversation across familiar topics with follow-up questions, explanations and reactions

missions.title: Reading Mastery — The Big Adventure
missions.focus: 650–800 word A2 story with main idea, details, sequence, context vocabulary and inference

missions.title: Listening Mastery — A Day of Real English
missions.focus: 7–9 minute mixed-format listening with dialogue, announcement, interview and everyday instructions

missions.title: Writing Mastery — Real Messages
missions.focus: practical email/message writing: request, invitation, apology, explanation, confirmation and simple complaint

missions.title: Storytelling Mastery — From Picture to Story
missions.focus: 250–300 word narrative with setting, characters, sequence, problem, solution and personal response

missions.title: Travel Master Mission
missions.focus: planning and completing a journey using transport, hotel, airport, directions, schedules and problem solving

missions.title: Health, Safety & Emergency Mission
missions.focus: describe symptoms or incidents clearly, understand instructions and communicate essential information under pressure

missions.title: Mini Presentation — My World
missions.focus: 3–5 minute prepared presentation with opening, organized points, examples, reasons and conclusion

missions.title: English-Only Final Challenge
missions.focus: communicate unknown vocabulary through descriptions, examples, paraphrase, clarification and repair strategies

missions.title: A2 Final Skills Marathon
missions.focus: large integrated review covering vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, reading, listening, speaking, writing and real-life English

missions.title: GRADE 1 FINAL MASTER QUEST — MAGIC ENGLISH A2
missions.focus: ultimate multi-stage assessment combining real-life scenarios, conversation, reading, listening, writing, storytelling, presentation and mastery review

content_targets.core_vocabulary: 750+ active words, phrases and collocations across Grade 1
content_targets.reading: 650–800 word A2 texts with main idea, detail, sequence, context vocabulary and inference
content_targets.listening: 7–9 minute mixed-format A2 listening with everyday speech, announcements and short interviews
content_targets.speaking: 10-minute sustained conversation plus a 3–5 minute prepared presentation
content_targets.writing: 250–300 word narrative plus practical emails/messages and explanations
content_targets.mastery: Grade 1 learner completes the beginner-to-A2 pathway with the ability to understand and produce connected English about familiar topics, manage common real-life interactions, describe past experiences, discuss current situations and future plans, explain simple problems, ask and answer follow-up questions, write practical messages and short stories, and communicate with substantially reduced dependence on translation.

final_assessment.completion_standard: Demonstrated A2-level control across integrated receptive and productive skills rather than completion based only on memorization.
